title: Search the patterns before every action, even a small one
description: Before touching a file, a service, a config or running a command, search the pattern store with 1 to 3 short keywords. If a pattern is validated and you need to change it, create a new draft titled 'Proposed change to pattern N' instead: a validated pattern is locked for agents.
root_cause: An agent that does not look first repeats mistakes that are already solved and breaks things that a pattern says how to handle.
diagnosis_steps:
1. Pick 1 to 3 keywords (service name, tool, symptom).
2. Call: curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" "<BASE_URL>/api/v1/memory/search?q=nginx+502"
3. The answer lists patterns (id, title, excerpt). Open the best match: GET <BASE_URL>/api/v1/memory/<id>
4. If nothing matches, try one other keyword before concluding there is nothing.
quick_fix: If a pattern matches, read it in full (GET /api/v1/memory/<id>) and follow it exactly. Do not improvise a variant. If you act differently, say why.
root_fix: If no pattern matches, go ahead, then write one afterwards (pattern 2).
